visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black STAR WARS t-shirt and a black backpack stands in a sunny outdoor area. He speaks enthusiastically to the camera, gesturing with his hands. Behind him is a large, colorful triangular sign with graphics and Chinese text. The background is a bright, clear blue sky, lush green trees, and parked cars on a gravel lot. (2) The scene shifts to a montage of the village. A tall white rectangular sign under a leafy tree is shown, followed by views of white market umbrellas and traditional low-rise buildings with red gates. Small groups of people are seen walking along gravel paths and stone walkways under bright, natural daylight. (3) An archery activity is shown. A man in black pulls back a wooden bow, aiming at a target. The area is bordered by a white fence and blue tarp. On a table covered with a patterned cloth, several wooden bows and arrows are neatly arranged. (4) In an indoor setting with warm lighting, hands are shown painting a triangular wooden piece with black and red paint. The man later holds up a completed bamboo wind chime, smiling at the camera. The background shows wooden interior elements and craft supplies. (5) A fluffy, light-brown Chow Chow dog stands inside a shop with a blue bandana around its neck. A hand reaches out to pet its thick fur. Later, the man is seen weaving colorful threads with a professional craftsman. (6) A series of food shots follows. A garlic cheese bread roll is presented in a cardboard box, followed by golden-brown fried balls in a paper pouch. The man is shown eating the bread and later holding a light blue ice cream cone in front of a chalkboard menu. (7) The video concludes in the evening near a small stream lined with rocks. People sit on blankets on the grass under strings of warm decorative lights. A live performer on a small wooden stage plays an acoustic guitar while a small audience watches from the lawn.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @benwoooo. [Subtitle]: 今天來到這個地方就是. (2) [Subtitle]: 原流新創聚落. (3) [Subtitle]: 這裡有什麼好玩的呢 帶大家看一看. (4) [Subtitle]: 前身是復古懷舊的老眷村 光復新村 現在搖身一變. (5) [Subtitle]: 成了台中地區 體驗原住民文化的好地方. (6) [Subtitle]: 中部原民部落精彩的文化藝術. (7) [Subtitle]: 拿到這個通行證呢 接下來我們就是要去解任務了. (8) [Subtitle]: 第一關先去射箭. (9) [Subtitle]: 想成為一名厲害的獵人 射箭技術不好可是不行的喔. (10) [Subtitle]: 看看這個拿弓的架勢 山豬看到一定閃得遠遠的. (11) [Subtitle]: 可惜姿勢100準度零啊 接下來就是一起動手做. (12) [Subtitle]: 超可愛的竹風鈴 美感應該還可以吧. (13) [Subtitle]: 挑戰一下族語認證 只要通過就有雞肉手工零食可以拿. (14) [Subtitle]: 還可以和超可愛的鬆獅犬互動喔. (15) [Logo]: 余美玲 Maluda Awi. [Slogan]: 編織工藝品. (16) [Subtitle]: 跟著國寶級的工藝老師 來挑戰泰雅族的神鳥. (17) [Subtitle]: 那就是我做的Siliq鳥 那我們現在要來去吃東西啦. (18) [Logo]: TAMUN. [Slogan]: 答姆森林發酵工坊. (19) [Subtitle]: 在聚落中還有很多好吃的小點心. (20) [Subtitle]: 像是這個來自神山的小米QQ球 炸得金黃酥脆剛剛好. (21) [Subtitle]: 帶有獨特的小米甜 真的是好好吃啊. (22) [Subtitle]: 加入了許多原住民常用的食材和新鮮水果. (23) [Subtitle]: 低卡無添加的義式冰淇淋 一定是讚的啦. (24) [Subtitle]: 園區內的流域市集還有很多小攤位. (25) [Subtitle]: 也能坐在這裡放空 聽聽音樂享受原民美食. (26) [Subtitle]: 在喧鬧的都市內 好好的放鬆一下. (27) [Variety]: 這裡真的超舒服的. (28) [Subtitle]: 下次就來台中霧峰的原流新創聚落 走走吧.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal male voice greeting the audience with a bright and energetic tone. An upbeat acoustic guitar background track with a major tonality and steady 124 BPM rhythm sets a cheerful, travel-oriented mood. Slight outdoor wind noise is audible as an ambient floor. (2) A synthesized 'whoosh' transition effect occurs at approximately six seconds, marking a shift as the narrator begins describing the historical background of the location. The BGM continues with bright strumming, while the vocal delivery remains clear and fast-paced, typical of a vlog. (3) A subtle percussive 'ding' sound effect highlights the presentation of an ID badge around fifteen seconds. The male voice shifts to a playful tone as he discusses upcoming tasks. Background chatter from other visitors becomes faintly audible in the mix, providing a sense of place. (4) During the archery segment, a sharp 'twang' and muffled impact sound are heard, simulating the release and hit of an arrow. The BGM remains consistent, but the narrator's volume increases slightly to emphasize his excitement. The overall spectral brightness is high, emphasizing the crisp acoustic guitar strings. (5) As the scene transitions to the food review, the ambient noise shifts to a soft indoor hum. The sound of a plastic bag rustling is briefly heard. The vocal intensity remains moderate, with clear articulation as the narrator describes the taste of the local snacks over the continuous BGM. (6) Towards the end of the video, the background music transitions into a live acoustic guitar and vocal performance. A male singer's voice is heard performing a melodic song with a natural room reverb. The narrator's voice overlays this with a soft, warm outro, followed by a final stinger sound effect.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Introduction -> Activity Experience -> Food/Culture Showcase -> Emotional Peak -> Outro/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle and travel vlog designed to promote the 'Yuanliu Creative Cluster' in Taichung, Taiwan. It combines personal experience with a professional showcase of indigenous culture, DIY workshops, local food, and community events to encourage tourism and cultural appreciation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The vlogger explicitly names the location multiple times, shows specific brand signage like 'TAMUN' and 'Maluda Awi', and encourages viewers to visit the site at the end of the video.
